:::writing{variant="email" id="73184" subject="Welcome to The TLC Team + Onboarding Next Steps"}
Happy Friday Kasey!  

We are so excited to officially have you joining The Luxora Collective team and stepping into the role of one of our primary closers. We truly believe you are going to be such an incredible addition to the culture, vision, and long-term growth of what we are building here at TLC.  

Please find your onboarding next steps outlined below:  

Step 1 - Join Our Slack Channel  
You will shortly receive an invite to our Slack workspace. This is our primary communication hub for the entire team and where all day-to-day communication, updates, call discussions, wins, questions, and support happen. Please make sure to join as soon as you receive the invite and turn your notifications on.  

Step 2 - Access Your Google Drive Folder  
We have put together a designated onboarding folder for you that contains the primary sales and onboarding materials we use internally.  

Inside, you will find:  
• Growth Assessment Call Preparation Sheets  
• Luxora Growth Engine Revenue Leak Call Script  
• Revenue Leak Call Tool  
• Sales Process Link Library  
• The Luxora Collective One-Pager  
• Client Onboarding SOP  
• Additional sales and positioning resources our team uses during the closing process  

These materials are designed to help familiarize you with our sales process, messaging, client journey, and overall Luxora ecosystem before onboarding next week.  

Step 3 - Review Deliverables & Client Journey  
Once a client signs with us, our team walks them through a much deeper onboarding and implementation process. During your onboarding next week, the leadership team will walk you through:  

• Our full deliverable stack  
• What clients receive after signing  
• Offer positioning and expectations  
• Client communication flow  
• CRM and systems overview  
• Objection handling and consultative sales flow  
• How our internal processes operate post-close  

We want you to feel fully equipped and confident understanding not only how to close the sale, but also exactly what happens after the contract is signed so you can confidently communicate the full Luxora experience.  

Step 4 - Team Onboarding Next Week  
Our leadership team will be connecting with you next week to go through onboarding in much greater detail and help get you fully integrated into the TLC ecosystem. We are incredibly excited to get rolling together and truly believe this is just the beginning of something very special.  

We are beyond excited to have you aboard, Kasey. Welcome to The TLC Team!  

Bethany Anne  
Co-Founder & CEO | The Luxora Collective  
📧 bethany@theluxoracollective.co  
🌐 urlThe Luxora Collectivehttps://www.theluxoracollective.co
:::

Subject: Welcome to The Luxora Collective, Kasey!  

Hey Kasey,  

We are so excited to officially welcome you into The Luxora Collective family and have you step into the role of our main closer. After our conversations, we truly feel like your experience, personality, and energy align so well with where we are headed as a company, and we are excited for you to become a long-term part of the team as we continue building and scaling together.  

Attached are some of the core resources, tools, and internal documents we use for our Growth Assessment Calls and sales process so you can start familiarizing yourself with our systems, messaging, and client journey ahead of onboarding next week. These materials will help give you clarity on:  

• Our Revenue Leak Audit process  
• Growth Assessment Call structure  
• Sales flow and positioning  
• Client onboarding process  
• Luxora messaging and deliverables  
• The overall client experience we aim to create  

You will also see some of the internal tools and SOPs we use daily as a team.  

Next week during onboarding, we will walk through everything together in much greater detail, including:  

• Our full client deliverables  
• Sales expectations and KPIs  
• Our ideal client profile  
• Offer positioning and objection handling  
• CRM and systems walkthrough  
• Communication expectations and team structure  
• Future growth opportunities within the company  

We really want you to feel fully equipped, supported, and confident stepping into this role because this is not just a temporary position to us. We are building something long-term and are looking for people who truly want to grow with the company and become part of a tight-knit ecosystem.  

We are genuinely excited to have you aboard and cannot wait to get rolling together next week.  

Talk soon,  

Bethany Anne  
Co-Founder & CEO | The Luxora Collective  
Growth Partners for Med Spa Owners Ready to Scale  
📧 bethany@theluxoracollective.co  
🌐 urlThe Luxora Collectivehttps://www.theluxoracollective.co

Bethany Anne <bethany@theluxoracollective.co>
Attachments
Mon, May 18, 5:45 PM (4 days ago)
to kaseyfant@gmail.com

Hey Kasey,

First off, thank you again for taking the time to speak with me today. I genuinely enjoyed our conversation and honestly walked away feeling even more excited about the possibility of having you join The Luxora Collective family.

After hearing your background, your experience in aesthetics, leadership, sales, operations, and entrepreneurship, I truly feel like your personality and skill set align so naturally with where we are headed. Beyond the experience itself, I can tell you genuinely care about people, client outcomes, company culture, and building something meaningful, and that matters tremendously to me.

I also just want to say how much I respect your story. The resilience, growth, and passion you have carried through some incredibly difficult seasons is inspiring, and I truly believe that kind of life experience creates the best leaders and communicators.

As discussed, our vision for Luxora is much bigger than just another marketing agency. We are building a true growth and consulting ecosystem for med spa owners that combines:
• Revenue Leak Audits
• Market Blueprint strategy
• Membership and package systems
• AI implementation and CRM automation
• Sales and operational consulting
• Team education and accountability
• Marketing and retention systems
• Long-term scalability for aesthetic businesses

Right now, we are in an exciting growth phase where we are actively building the foundation and core leadership team that will help us scale this into something truly massive over the next few years.

Your role would primarily focus on:
• High-ticket closing
• Helping guide owners through the Luxora vision
• Supporting consultative sales conversations
• Building trust and relationships with prospects
• Potentially helping train or oversee future closers/setters as we grow
• Becoming part of the long-term evolution of the company

 Also, while we get everything ramped up and the setter team fully dialed in, we would absolutely love any help you’re willing to give on the front-end setting side as well, just so we can all continue pushing the vision forward together as a team.  

Initially, this would begin as a 1099 commission-based role while we continue scaling, but as discussed, the long-term vision absolutely includes growth opportunities, increased commission structures, leadership opportunities, and eventually transitioning key team members into more permanent long-term positions with additional benefits and compensation structures as the company expands.

One of the biggest things I want you to know is that we are building this very intentionally. We are not looking for “just sales people.” We are looking for people who believe in the mission, care about clients, want to grow with us long-term, and want to help shape the future of the company alongside us.

Attached, I’m sending over:
• Our one-page overview of The Luxora Collective and our core offers
• Additional information on our systems and growth structure
• Check out our website to continue exploring the vision and positioning (www.theluxoracollective.co)
• Additional details on what our client journey and process looks like

I’d love for you to take some time to review everything, sleep on it, pray on it, talk with Rachel, and just sit with the vision a little bit. I truly believe this could become something really special for the right people involved early.

I’m incredibly excited about the possibility of working together and building something amazing.
